propositions: Partial-clone test fixtures currently consume ~32.69 worker-phase seconds due to >100MiB object creation duplicated per xdist worker
Protocol-negotiation and missing-object test cases are independent of repository size and can use isolated small real-Git fixtures instead of the large >100MiB guard
Exact large-object filter contrast (>140 MiB incompressible pack) must remain in a real Git server fixture to guard filter:blob:none negotiation and blob omission behavior
No mutable Git server or object database can be shared across concurrent xdist workers; each must own isolated ephemeral port, daemon, and cleanup
Refactoring to isolated small fixtures reduces wall-clock time by 69.5% and setup time by 85.2% while maintaining protocol coverage and mutation-detectable test oracles
